# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

label_pretty <- function(x) {
  return(format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE, drop0trailing = TRUE))
}
```

Load in results from Extinct and Extant simulations:

```{r load-results}
C1_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extinct/initials.rds")
C2_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extinct/initials.rds")
C3_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extinct/initials.rds")
C4_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extinct/initials.rds")

C1_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
C2_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
C3_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
C4_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extinct/thresholds.rds")

C1_errorrates <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extant/error_rates.rds")
C2_errorrates <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extant/error_rates.rds")
C3_errorrates <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extant/error_rates.rds")
C4_errorrates <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extant/error_rates.rds")
```

# Extinct Comparison

Compare C1 with C2, C3, and C4:

```{r extinct-comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4
C12_initials <- left_join(C1_initials, C2_initials, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(power_difference = power.y - power.x)
C13_initials <- left_join(C1_initials, C3_initials, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(power_difference = power.y - power.x)
C14_initials <- left_join(C1_initials, C4_initials, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(power_difference = power.y - power.x)

C12_thresholds <- left_join(C1_thresholds, C2_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(threshold_difference = threshold.y / threshold.x)
C13_thresholds <- left_join(C1_thresholds, C3_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(threshold_difference = threshold.y / threshold.x)
C14_thresholds <- left_join(C1_thresholds, C4_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(threshold_difference = threshold.y / threshold.x)

C12_comparison <- left_join(C12_initials, C12_thresholds, by = "model")
C13_comparison <- left_join(C13_initials, C13_thresholds, by = "model")
C14_comparison <- left_join(C14_initials, C14_thresholds, by = "model")

C12_extinct_plot <- ggplot(C12_comparison) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_difference, y = threshold_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Difference in Power at Time of Extinction",
    y = "Relative Difference in Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C1 (Null) vs C2 (Declining Detectability)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(1e-1, 1e1),
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10),
    labels = label_pretty
  )

C13_extinct_plot <- ggplot(C13_comparison) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_difference, y = threshold_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Difference in Power at Time of Extinction",
    y = "Relative Difference in Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C1 (Null) vs C3 (Increasing Survey Effort)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(1e-1, 1e1),
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10),
    labels = label_pretty
  )

C14_extinct_plot <- ggplot(C14_comparison) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_difference, y = threshold_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Difference in Power at Time of Extinction",
    y = "Relative Difference in Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C1 (Null) vs C4 (Combined)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(1e-1, 1e1),
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10),
    labels = label_pretty
  )

ggarrange(C12_extinct_plot, C13_extinct_plot, C14_extinct_plot, ncol = 3)
```

# Extant Comparison

Compare C1 with C2, C3, and C4:

```{r extant-comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4
C12_errorrates <- left_join(C1_errorrates, C2_errorrates, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_difference = mean_error_rate.y - mean_error_rate.x,
    slope_difference = slope.y - slope.x
  )
C13_errorrates <- left_join(C1_errorrates, C3_errorrates, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_difference = mean_error_rate.y - mean_error_rate.x,
    slope_difference = slope.y - slope.x
  )
C14_errorrates <- left_join(C1_errorrates, C4_errorrates, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_difference = mean_error_rate.y - mean_error_rate.x,
    slope_difference = slope.y - slope.x
  )

C12_extant_plot <- ggplot(C12_errorrates) +
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_difference, y = slope_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Difference in Mean of Type I Error Rate",
    y = "Absolute Difference in Slope of Type I Error Rate",
    title = "C1 (Null) vs C2 (Declining Detectability)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)
  )

C13_extant_plot <- ggplot(C13_errorrates) +
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_difference, y = slope_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Difference in Mean of Type I Error Rate",
    y = "Absolute Difference in Slope of Type I Error Rate",
    title = "C1 (Null) vs C3 (Increasing Survey Effort)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)
  )

C14_extant_plot <- ggplot(C14_errorrates) +
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_difference, y = slope_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Difference in Mean of Type I Error Rate",
    y = "Absolute Difference in Slope of Type I Error Rate",
    title = "C1 (Null) vs C4 (Combined)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)
  )

ggarrange(C12_extant_plot, C13_extant_plot, C14_extant_plot, ncol = 3)
```
